instruction: Notify the owner with the exact action, payout, deadline, risk, prepared artifacts and evidence; continue all reversible work meanwhile.

evidence: Commission Dental E-Book Sales 6 days left Verified I’ve just finished a series of in-depth e-books for dental professionals that focus on one thing: proven lead-generation strategies to grow a dental practice. The content is ready, the landing pages are live, and the payment gateway is set up—I now need a driven sales partner who will earn purely on commission for every copy moved. Target market is - USA Dentists. Your role is to take full ownership of outreach and closing: • Identify and engage practising dentists, practice managers, and group practices through channels such as LinkedIn, Facebook groups, email lists, and industry forums. • Nurture prospects with value-first messaging, demos, or sample chapters and convert interest into paid downloads. • Keep basic tracking in a spreadsheet or your preferred... Content Marketing CRM Data Entry Digital Marketing Email Marketing Excel Internet Marketing Lead Generation Leads Sales $6 - $16 $6 - $16 0 bids Bid now
human_actions: Authorize use of a truthful Freelancer.com account and review/accept the platform terms so Louis OS can submit the already prepared proposal or quote. Do not complete KYC or configure payout unless the platform explicitly requests it later.
payment_methods: Freelancer milestone payment; account payout method selected after award
rationale: hours and page volume are scoring inputs, not standalone rejection gates
headline prize size is not used as the primary ranking signal
items.risk_summary: risk=0.20; platform account and terms gate only; KYC, payout and contract actions remain deferred until explicitly required
